title: ononis aragonensis f. microphylla
intro: Ononis aragonensis f. microphylla, commonly known as the Dwarf Spanish Restharrow, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Ononis aragonensis f. microphylla include treating gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, as well as its potential anti-diabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
